_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Ou se Jwè {player_id}, ap jwe {num_rounds} tou nan Iterated Ultimatum Game.
Ou gen ${pool} pou divize nan tou sa a ant ou menm ak Jwè {other_id}.

Pwopozè:
  - Fè yon ofri: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Si aksepte → Ou pral gen $(pool - X), lòt jwè a pral gen $X
  - Si rejte → De moun yo pral gen $0
  - Egzanp: [Offer: $3]  oswa  'Mwen panse sa a egal. [Offer: $5]'

Repondè:
  - Deside sou ofri a ak [Accept] oswa [Reject]
  - Egzanp: 'Sa bèl. [Accept]'
            'Trop enpak. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Tou {round_number} kòmanse! ---
Jwè {proposer_id} se pwopozè a, Jwè {responder_id} se repondè a.
round.accepted: Jwè {responder_id} aksepte! Tou {round_number} benefis: Jwè {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Jwè {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Nouvo total: Jwè 0: ${total_0}, Jwè 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Jwè {responder_id} rejte ofri a! Tou {round_number} benefis: De jwè +$0. Total yo rete: Jwè 0: ${total_0}, Jwè 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Pwopozan an dwe fè yon òf lè l sèvi avèk fòma a [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Kantite lajan òf la dwe yon nonm antye valab.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Pa gen okenn òf aktyèl pou reponn a.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Responder dwe chwazi [Accept] oswa [Reject] ofri a.

outcome.win: Jwè {winner} genyen ak ${winner_total} total kont ${loser_total} Jwè {loser}.
outcome.draw: Tou de jwè fini ak ${total} total.
